tasks.title: Scan the repository and identify the current implementation surface
Discovery and Architecture: Understand the goal, inspect the current repository, and define the target architecture.
Core Implementation: Build the minimum complete backend and domain logic required for the requested capability.
Integration: Connect the new capability with GARUDA Mother, workers, memory, and reporting.
Validation: Verify syntax, behavior, governance, and safe execution.
Delivery: Prepare a founder-reviewable result with clear changes, risks, and next actions.
Define validation checks and read-only test strategy
Review the merged proposal for safety and approval boundaries
